text:
All caps headings. Justified text. Information hidden in images. Scanned documents nobody can search. Broken links. Staff who left years ago. Each one looks like a detail. Now multiply it by a hundred schools. Two hundred. Five hundred. A thousand, and counting.

Every school has the same duties: accessibility, data protection, security, and rules that keep changing. Most face them alone, with their own budget and their own contractor. So quality comes down to chance.

And every few years: a new tender, a new website. The tree is cut back to a stump and planted again. And again. Ours is never cut down. It keeps growing, and every new rule only makes it stronger.

Cleverphant is shared digital infrastructure for schools. What people see is the website. Underneath is everything that keeps it right, from one design system to compliance and support, shared by every school. A new school simply plugs in.

Because every school runs on the same system, they all get the same benefits, and the same bugs. But it takes just one school to notice. Fixed once, fixed for all.

Ideas travel the same way. A curious school leader brings a need. Their school becomes the pilot. Slow. Very slow. Then the data shows it works, and every school has it at once.

And it works from the top, too. A municipality or a ministry publishes a new rule or a campaign once, and it appears on every school website at the same time.

A small village school gets what a large city school gets. One design system underneath; the face stays the school's own. Not identical. Equally good.

Change starts with details. Being small is no excuse to look away. Elephants are slow. Very slow. So slow that nobody notices the change, until it's everywhere. That's our Trojan elephant. And every next step lands on every school: live tables, whistleblower channels, consultation booking, surveys, event calendars, update subscriptions.

And we keep asking: what if? What if a teacher's Word file became a finished article? What if documents named and filed themselves? What if a fix was ready before you saw the problem? None of this needs a new website. Each idea is an app on the same foundation. One school pilots it, every school gets it.

And AI? Not another chatbot. AI that quietly keeps things in order. Because AI loves order.

What works in one school works in a municipality, a region, a whole country. Schools can be added quickly, while costs grow far more slowly. Not a promise of cheap. The logic of scale.

We have walked this road for fifteen years. The first ten? Slow. Very slow. So slow. Then the network started to grow by itself: hundreds of institutions, whole municipalities on one standard, with content audits, onboarding and a training platform. Built in a small country. Ready for yours. Let's talk about your region.

Thank you for watching.
